description: The persistent base fort in the running game on map 04 (area stage 2): close and wide, with the player at the north gate; noon, dusk and night.

warmup.code: const lp = await import('/src/utils/localPreferences.ts'); lp.setStoredPersistentBaseAreaStage(1); lp.setStoredPersistentBaseAreaStage(2); if (lp.getStoredCoopDefenseProgress().persistentBaseAreaStage !== 2) throw new Error('area stage not set'); const r = dev.run({action:'start', scenario: {version:1, seed:12345, classId:'inspector_gadachs', hideAim:true, hideTutorial:true, suppressWaves:true, freezeMission:true, mapId:'4', player:{gridX:77, gridY:14}, timeOfDay: ck.timeOfDay() ?? 720}}); if (!r.ok) throw new Error('restart failed: ' + r.error); for (let i = 0; i < 600; i++) { const s = dev.status(); if (s.ready && s.paused) break; await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 100)); }
